display.summary: Settings and operations patch: other sections no longer wipe the system name, previews keep the viewer's theme, Operations checks only on request.
highlights: Saving an Options section other than Branding no longer resets the project name to DjangoLux.
The live settings preview keeps your personal theme unless you change the default theme.
Operations opens without starting checks, shows what is running, and pairs with Composer 1.9.0b2 for executor-side secrets diagnostics.
Personal column layouts use the Tables builder strip from an icon-only ribbon action; administrators can turn them off per table.
Includes the 1.14.1 sticky-form and personal-column fixes, Mono builder contrast fixes and the 1.15.1b2 ScanLink fixes.
